teaser: Companies that sell research could deliver it as a vault: evidence, a fractal graph, briefings per reader, behaviour policies for AI products, a lane back.
core_idea: Research is sold by subscription and delivered as documents, one reading for everyone; delivered as an sgit vault it becomes findings with evidence, a fractal graph instead of one taxonomy, a briefing per reader, calculations, a branded app and an append lane back, refreshed as commits; for AI-enabled products the research should include an Agent Behaviour Policy with and without the AI, over which the firm judges licence to operate and insurability; the evidence can come from a governed agent hive with a ledger, and the whole can be sold by the block.
